nena-1998.notes: Both copies were filed under other editions (nena-1997, nena-1999) and are now placed here. Source 9 has six problems while the catalogue knows seven for this contest; its file name says 1999 but its text matches the PDF titled '1998 Northeast North America Programming Contest'. Source 4 prints seven unlabelled problem columns and no contest day (only a last-updated date, October 26, 1998).

sources.evidence: The page is titled ACM Northeast North America Championship Round Results (1998-9), lists 12 teams and states it was last updated October 26, 1998.
The text of the six problems is identical, apart from a title line, to the PDF titled 1998 Northeast North America Programming Contest that our archive holds for this contest.
